name: Thievery
description: Taking, Opening, The Quiet Transfer of Ownership. Thievery is the applied art of things ending up somewhere else. It is not Freedom, which unbinds on principle, nor Trickery, which misleads — it simply moves what was held into a hand that was not meant to hold it, and it is very good at not being noticed doing so. Wards, locks and pockets are, to a Thievery wielder, all the same kind of problem.

minor.name: Lightened
minor.card: one thing it was carrying is gone

major.name: Disarmed
major.card: its weapon is in your hand

severe.name: Stripped
severe.card: Incapacitated — everything it relied on is missing

offensive.name: The Lift
offensive.description: The wound is incidental. You came for what they were carrying.

tiers.text: The damage becomes piercing. A creature hit or that fails loses one object it carries — your choice, and it is in your hand.
tiers.card: Damage becomes Piercing · take one thing it carries, into your hand

tiers.text: Against a creature that did not see you coming, the seal deals 4 additional dice.
tiers.card: +4 dice if it never saw you coming

tiers.text: What you take may be immaterial: one prepared spell, one use of a feature, or the attack it had readied — you hold it, and may spend it before your next long rest.
tiers.card: Steal a prepared spell, a feature use, or its readied attack — and spend it yourself

tiers.text: Cleaned Out. A creature that fails loses every object it is holding and one it is wearing, all of which land wherever you like within 30 feet.
tiers.card: CLEANED OUT — everything held and one thing worn, dropped where you choose

supportive.name: Light Fingers
supportive.description: Everything they touch comes away easier than it should.

tiers.text: For 1 hour the target has advantage on Sleight of Hand and Stealth checks, and can pick any non-magical lock or pocket without tools.
tiers.card: 1 hr: advantage on Sleight of Hand and Stealth · no tools needed

tiers.text: It may Disengage and Hide as one bonus action, and moving through an enemy's space costs it nothing.
tiers.card: Disengage and Hide as one bonus action · enemies' spaces cost nothing

tiers.text: Once per turn when it hits a creature, it may take one object that creature carries, without a check.
tiers.card: Once a turn on a hit: take something they're carrying, no check

tiers.text: Nothing Is Nailed Down. The target may steal what cannot be picked up: a sound, a shadow, a handful of fire, the light from a lantern, the weight of a thing — each held for 1 minute and usable once.
tiers.card: NOTHING IS NAILED DOWN — steal a sound, a shadow, a flame, a weight · hold it a minute

control.name: The Lockless Room
control.description: Nothing here is secured, including the things people are holding.

tiers.text: For 1 minute, every lock, latch, buckle and clasp in the area is open, and creatures that fail drop one object they are holding.
tiers.card: 1 min: every lock and buckle opens · those who fail drop something

tiers.text: Creatures that failed can't don, draw or retrieve anything: no swapping weapons, no drinking a potion, no reaching for a component pouch, while they remain.
tiers.card: Those who failed can't draw, don or retrieve anything inside

tiers.text: Wards fail too: any magical seal, alarm, glyph or ward of the slot level or lower in the area is suppressed while the effect lasts.
tiers.card: Wards, glyphs and alarms (≤ slot) are suppressed inside

tiers.text: Everything Moves. At the start of each of your turns you may move one unattended object in the area, or one object held by a creature that failed, to anywhere else in the area — including into your hand.
tiers.card: EVERYTHING MOVES — each turn, relocate any object in the area, held or not

creation.name: The Tools
creation.description: Made to open things, and to be found on nobody.

tiers.text: Your creations are never found on you: they can be hidden about your person undetectably and produced as a free action.
tiers.card: Creations hide undetectably on you and appear as a free action

tiers.text: Your Objects open things: any one lock, ward, seal or container of the slot level or lower, once each, without a sound.
tiers.card: Objects open one lock, ward or seal (≤ slot) each, silently

tiers.text: Your Constructs steal: once per turn, one may take an object from a creature within its reach on a hit, and bring it to you.
tiers.card: Constructs lift things on a hit and bring them to you

tiers.text: Make a Ghost Key: a permanent Object that opens any lock, ward or door its bearer has previously seen opened by someone else — once per such door, per day.
tiers.card: A GHOST KEY — opens any door you've watched somebody else open

utility.name: The Job
utility.description: Ninety percent of a theft is knowing what is where, and who is looking.

tiers.text: Know where the valuables are within 60 feet, what is trapped, and which way people are facing.
tiers.card: Know what's valuable, what's trapped, and who's looking, within 60 ft

tiers.text: Open any lock, ward or container you can touch of the slot level or lower, leaving no trace it was opened.
tiers.card: Open any lock or ward (≤ slot), leaving no trace

tiers.text: Take something you can see within 60 feet into your hand, silently, if nobody is holding it — and leave behind something of the same size and weight so it is not missed.
tiers.card: Take an unheld thing within 60 ft, and leave a convincing weight in its place

tiers.text: Steal the fact of it: for a week, nobody remembers the thing you took existed, including whoever owned it. The gap in the ledger balances itself.
tiers.card: For a week, nobody remembers the thing you took ever existed

complementEffects.name: Pickpocket
complementEffects.description: Something came away with the seal.

effect.text: On a hit or failed saving throw, the target takes bonus piercing damage equal to one damage die of the primary effect's type (min 1d6) and drops one object it is holding.

upgrades.text: Level 5+: Two dice, and the object lands in your hand instead of the ground.
upgrades.card: +2 dice · it lands in your hand

upgrades.text: Level 11+: Three dice, and against an unaware target the seal deals its damage dice twice.
upgrades.card: +3 dice · double dice if it never saw you

complementEffects.name: Quick Hands
complementEffects.description: The seal leaves its targets faster with their hands than they were.

effect.text: Each of the seal's targets may draw, stow or retrieve any number of objects as a free action, and has advantage on its next Sleight of Hand or Stealth check.
effect.card: The seal's targets: free item handling · advantage on their next Sleight of Hand or Stealth

buff.advantage: the next Sleight of Hand or Stealth check

upgrades.text: Level 5+: It lasts 1 minute, and each may Disengage as a bonus action.
upgrades.card: 1 min · Disengage as a bonus action

upgrades.text: Level 11+: Once each, on a hit, a target may take an object the creature carries.
upgrades.card: Once each: lift something on a hit

complementEffects.name: Unlatched
complementEffects.description: Everything around where it landed is suddenly not secured.

effect.text: Every lock, latch and buckle within 15 feet of the point of impact opens, and creatures that failed the seal's save can't retrieve or draw a stowed item until the end of their next turn.
effect.card: 15 ft: everything unlocks · those who failed can't draw or retrieve

upgrades.text: Level 5+: Wards and alarms of 3rd level or lower in the area are suppressed for 1 minute.
Level 11+: You may move one unattended object in the area to your hand.
upgrades.card: Pull one unattended object to your hand
